tagline: The company designs and sells high-performance gaming and streaming peripherals, components and systems to enthusiasts globally.
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI represents the gaming components and systems segment, which includes PCs and AI workstations. It is critical as it demonstrates the company's ability to capitalize on the growing market for high-performance PCs and AI workstations.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin measures production efficiency and product pricing effectiveness.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in gross margin profitability, indicating better cost management or increased pricing power.

kpis.name: Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue after deductions for returns and discounts.
kpis.description: Net revenue represents the total amount of company sales.
kpis.signal: Strong revenue growth, demonstrating sustained demand for the company's products.

kpis.name: Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Total amount of company losses after all expenses.
kpis.description: Net loss is the final financial result when expenses exceed revenues.
kpis.signal: Significant reduction in net loss, indicating improvement in overall profitability.

kpis.name: Cash and Equivalents
kpis.explanation: Total amount of cash and assets readily convertible to cash.
kpis.description: Available cash is essential for current operations and strategic investments.
kpis.signal: Decrease in cash, potentially due to investments or acquisitions.

kpis.short: Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities
kpis.name: Net Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated by the company's core business activities.
kpis.description: This cash flow indicates the company's ability to generate liquidity from its operations.
kpis.signal: Strong increase in operating cash flows, a sign of improved operational efficiency.

kpis.name: New Products Launched
kpis.explanation: Number of new products introduced to the market during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: New product launches are a key indicator of the company's innovation strategy and growth.
kpis.signal: Significant launch of new products, signaling strong commitment to innovation and portfolio expansion.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 1.25 billion euros in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.19 billion euros in the latest year

kpis.name: Fanatec Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Fanatec, a sim racing product brand, to strengthen Corsair's position in this market.
kpis.description: The Fanatec acquisition aims to complement Corsair's existing offerings in gaming and sim racing.
kpis.signal: Strategic acquisition to expand product portfolio and market presence in sim racing.

risks.title: Unfavorable global macroeconomic conditions
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions 'challenging global macroeconomic conditions' (Item 7 MD&A). Challenges include inflation, elevated interest rates, substantial tariffs since February 2025, and geopolitical tensions (Ukraine, Middle East, Red Sea, China-Taiwan). The intensity of language and details provided justify high severity.

risks.title: Dependence on technology refresh cycles
risks.score_rationale: The report emphasizes the importance of new CPU and GPU introductions as demand drivers (Item 7 MD&A). The mention that 'demand moderated during 2024 as we entered into a mid-cycle period' and that 'demand in 2026 may be more consistent with mid-cycle conditions' indicates vulnerability to launch cycles.

risks.title: Intense competition in gaming and content creation markets
risks.score_rationale: The general business document (Item 1 Business) mentions that 'our solution is the most comprehensive suite of products among our main competitors', implying strong competition. The need to maintain market leadership through continuous innovation justifies high severity.

risks.title: Global supply chain risks and volatile tariffs
risks.score_rationale: The MD&A document (Item 7) explicitly details challenges: 'Since February 2025, the U.S. government has proposed and in certain cases implemented new, substantial tariffs on imports to the United States from various countries, including Taiwan, China and Vietnam, where we manufacture or source our products'. Corsair notes that 'while we mitigated the impact of new tariffs on our business to some extent during the year ended December 31, 2025, there can be no assurances that we will continue to be as effective'. This high severity is justified by uncertainty and direct impacts.

risks.title: Global semiconductor supply constraints and DRAM price increases
risks.score_rationale: The MD&A document (Item 7) states: 'We are currently observing significant constraints in the global supply of semiconductors driven by the proliferation of AI infrastructure, which are materially impacting the broader hardware market.' It specifies that 'Heightened demand for these components has driven commodity prices to high levels, resulting in a substantial increase in the market price of DRAM modules'. Corsair notes that 'our core market position is centered on the enthusiast-level PC builder, a demographic that historically demonstrates less price sensitivity than the broader market', which mitigates the impact somewhat.

ai_positioning.summary: The company has not mentioned AI, artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided excerpts from its 10-K report. Therefore, its positioning on these technologies is not apparent from this information.
